link.title: Provider Sharing
link.heading: Open This Link on a Computer
link.body: Provider sharing can only be requested and used in {{appName}} on a computer. Send the link to your computer and open it there, or paste it in Settings → Providers → Providers Shared with Me.
link.note: Share links expire 5 minutes after they’re created and work only once.
link.copyFailed: Couldn’t copy the share link. Try again in a moment.
